content:
Hi everyone! With help from Codex, I’ve managed to get a Lean proof of the Conway–Soifer conjecture for n = 3:

https://github.com/AnanasClassic/conway-soifer-n3-lean

I’m new to Lean. Would anyone be willing to take a look, especially at whether the definitions and theorem statement correctly capture the problem? Thanks!
This topic was moved here from #general > Conway–Soifer conjecture for n = 3 by Michael Rothgang.

Hi! Do you know about comparator or #formalization.yaml? Please use both, so outside users can be sure to see what your project actually proves. Without that, you'll find it difficult to find volunteers.
More generally, putting this on Palomar on Palomar (which requires the two things in my previous message) is good. It drastically increases your chances of getting attention.
